notes.title: 5 NEW STORIES ARE ALMOST THERE!
notes.content:
Hey there, friends! 

I'm finally here to tell you more about Furry Shades Of Gay 3. With the release date just two weeks ahead, it's time to dive deep into the new stories. 

Have you missed Percy and Blake? Are you ready to get to know Valentino and Alex? Have you missed going to a camp and meeting hot men and women? We've got your back! 

[h2]The Haunted House[/h2]

A long-term relationship requires some space, worthy of needs of a couple. Well, that's what Blake thinks. Percy, on the other hand, is happier when he has a comfortable high-tech house, filled with fancy adult toys. They have a lot to discuss on their way to the next house. 

Though this old Victorian manshion is not on their list, realtor insists they have to tour it. The house seems mysterious, and something tells Blake that they should be careful walking around the dusty rooms, but Percy is up for the adventure! 

Will a bottle of wine affect their love nest choice, or maybe something that hides in the dark corners will scare Percy and Blake away? Read the story and find out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/5b8322ede801b4df41620ecc3f27256f50fb264b.png[/img]

[h2]Hot Italian Vacation[/h2]

Alex is a local blog celebrity, and he's starving for new fun and relevant content, but everything seems too boring to him. He finds the interest in wineries in himself as soon as he finds out that the guy he used to see in college courses is a famous winery owner. 

It's not that Alex is interested in money, he's more satisfied with how Valentino has changed over ages. And he's on his way to find out if Valentino has changed his attitude as well. 

Will Valentino open to a new opportunity of reviving his old crush on Alex among the grapes? Help him make decisions in the story!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/671ff7cea445364248fb23075877723b8c293bea.png[/img]

[h2]Boss Calls In![/h2]

Office job is always very tense, there's no way to relax during the lunch break without catching anyone's attention. But Hugo is a very smart guy, and he spends his break chatting with mysterious BigB. 

He can't wait for their meeting later this week, so much he loses the focus during work and is more dedicated to taking pictures of his gorgeous body in red lingerie in the office toilet or sexting and planning the future hook-up. And that's why he catches his boss' attention. 

William likes it when his employees actually do the job they get paid for, because it usually means he doesn't have to stay late in the office and pursue living a life of a dominant man of every boy's dreams. That's why it's crucial to him that Hugo does his job properly - he has a date on Friday and he's going to make it happen no matter what. 

But somehow having Hugo around leaves him wondering if he's really up to a hook-up with someone unfamiliar. Besides, Hugo looks just like Baby he's been longing after...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/a4b935a25f2df0c6d373267a31b5a67f92346b54.png[/img]

[h2]Scouting Summer[/h2]

The camp term is over, the kids are gone, but there's still something else to do for the counselors - who wouldn't want a big goodbye party near the lake? Connor is a bit sad though, he's been going through a serious crysis, and today's the last day he can actually make some decisions about his awakened sexuality and another counselor Dan. 

Dan is an outstandingly easy-going guy, he's a little younger than Connor, but he beats him at every social activity, especially now, when their co-workers are gone to prepare a party full of beer and camp fires. Connor is not very good at picking up the hints and goes shy around Dan a lot. Dan is ready to take everything in his hands and lead this releationship onto a new level. 

But is Connor ready to come to terms with himself and his found interest in Dan? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/c0e0316e1ff843916024e5aec9053d97dbfdffd7.png[/img]

[h2]Rub and Romance[/h2]

Mikey's back is his pain... in the back! He's been promising himself a good workout season pass in the nearest gym for god knows how long. His lack of activity in this field has backstabbed him once again... literally. So, Mikey once again decides to call his masseur, but to his surprise, it's not her knocking on his door an hour later. 

Orlando is just a dream masseur - he knows where to rub and how to press on Mikey's soft body to relieve him of his pain and, apparently, turn him on. Mikey is fine with a sexy man massaging his ass cheeks and thighs, he just needs to figure out how to take care of his boner.
